business_problem: For 35 years, CP AXTRA has been the preferred food supplier for more than 4.0 million registered customers—comprising small food retailers, hotels, restaurants, small businesses, caterers, and private individuals. CP AXTRA has been committed to developing its operations, products, and services to meet the changing needs of its customers.
solution_summary: Innovation, technology, and operational excellence paved the way for CP AXTRA to become one of Thailand’s biggest wholesale retail businesses over the last three decades. The company was one of the early adopters of Copilot for Microsoft 365 in the country, kickstarting a digital transformation to increase organizational agility. After deploying Copilot, employees are already finding innovative ways to leverage AI to boost productivity and meet the demands of changing customer behavior. solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Assists employees inside Microsoft 365 apps with drafting, summarization, search, and task execution.

data_flow: One of the group’s priorities was to leverage AI to underpin B2B and B2C big data and upskill employees’ digital capabilities to meet the demands of a dynamic market. By utilizing AI, we can look at data across our entire value chain in a multitude of different ways—not only to react and respond quickly but also to try a whole new array of strategies,” says Shaun Wong, Group Chief Transformation Officer at CP AXTRA.
business_outcome: At the end of the day, this transformation will help CP AXTRA better adapt to evolving customer needs—enabling the company to continue its focus on its value chain and leverage AI to boost customer lifetime value. Copilot enables a multitude of solutions to improve the quality of customer interactions, whether it’s a custom chatbot that can minimize repetitive answers or upgrading its call center to take a more proactive approach to customer care that’s tailored to specific customer needs.
metrics: For 35 years, CP AXTRA has been the preferred food supplier for more than 4.0 million registered customers—comprising small food retailers, hotels, restaurants, small businesses, caterers, and private individuals.
